method: A 1x1 radial square (in the y=0 plane, centred at radius 10) swept along a right-hand helix r=10, pitch=3, turns=4. The helix twist means the Pappus product 2 pi xbar A turns is only an approximation of this swept solid, so volume/area/centroid/bbox are frozen from the kernel build (6 faces, 12 edges).
